report.title: What you download after 90 seconds
report.subtitle: An exhaustive, structured audit report, ready to steer your team's corrections.
report.simulationText: Acceptance likely with minor revisions. The manuscript ranks in the top 15% of submissions reviewed in this subfield.
report.synthText: The paper presents solid algorithmic contributions. Three critical points require your attention before submission to the review committee:

priorities.label: PRIORITY 1
priorities.title: Missing recent baselines (2024-2025)
priorities.desc: The Related Work section omits 2 major references cited in 87% of comparable papers.

priorities.label: PRIORITY 2
priorities.title: Confidence interval normalization
priorities.desc: Table 2: State whether the reported error corresponds to the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean (SEM).

priorities.label: PRIORITY 3
priorities.title: Code & Data Availability section
priorities.desc: The anonymized GitHub link (Zenodo / OpenScience) is not provided under the double-blind protocol.

report.exportNote: Available exports: PDF, LaTeX Diff & Markdown

checklist.title: Page 4 • Section 2.3: Specify the significance threshold
checklist.desc: Replace “The improvement was statistically remarkable” with “The proposed method yielded a statistically significant gain (p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 1.18)”.

checklist.title: Page 7 • Table 1: Clarify the SOTA abbreviation
checklist.desc: Define the comparative baseline in the table footnote to avoid complaints about asymmetric comparison.

checklist.title: Page 11 • Reproducibility statement: Add the hardware environment
checklist.desc: Specify the number of NVIDIA A100 GPUs, the pseudo-random seed (seed=42) and the average convergence time.

audience.title: Built specifically for research demands

items.benefit: Automatic elevation to the stylistic standards of Q1 international journals.
